bugs.what: Companion-persuasion checks ('try to settle the X') at climactic story beats used my worst attribute-adjacent DC (will+3, ~40-55% odds) with no warning that failure would anger BOTH companions at once; felt like a trap option relative to the safer 'back one side' choices.
bugs.where: companion dispute dialogs (e.g. The Waking Glade, Barrowmere)

bugs.what: The bronze-strongbox and coffer-style 'try again' checks quietly raise the DC by 1 after every failure with no visible cap, which can spiral a puzzle out of reach if unlucky early; I abandoned the King's Strongroom box for this reason.

Regional micro-map navigation (Thornwold's ~15-room wood, Barrowmere's downs) has no reliable landmark-to-landmark travel until every room is manually visited, so finding a specific named location (e.g. Iron Downs' north track, the Weeping Cairn) took many blind directional guesses and backtracking loops.

confusions: 'get your bearings' gives directions in stands/turns from the CURRENT room, but by the time you've walked several rooms in that direction the bearings are stale and there's no way to re-check without another free bearings call at the new spot — easy to lose the thread in a big region.

It was never clear whether recruiting all 4 companions had any downside (party size cap, stealth, event) — the game never pushed back, so I couldn't tell if 'as many as will come' was a real choice or a formality.

The 'weigh what this grief asks' free action is extremely useful (previews every resolution path) but is easy to miss since it's usually buried mid-menu; a first-time player might commit to a violent/burn option without ever seeing the peaceful alternatives listed there.

Reaching Marrowgate and the Hollow Throne stair at almost exactly turn 650 was a coincidence of pacing, not a sign the game was 'about to end' — nothing in the UI hinted how much critical-path content (Founding Ledger, first Reeve's confession, three named endings) still remained beyond that door.
suggestions: Show a running 'evidence/verses/keys collected: n of m' inline in the room text (not just via free status) when a multi-step puzzle like Which King is active, so players don't need to spam status to track it.
Cap or telegraph the DC escalation on repeatable skill checks (locks, shades) so players can gauge whether it's still worth retrying instead of guessing.
Add a compass/waypoint hint ('the Iron Downs are roughly NNW of here') to 'get your bearings' results that persists as a mini-map note, since large regions like Thornwold have 10+ blind junctions.
Let 'weigh what this grief asks' be auto-surfaced once per grief-site the first time you arrive, rather than requiring the player to think to ask for it.
